name: io.github.Evilander/audrey
description: Local-first biological memory for coding agents: recall, consolidation, and pre-action Guard checks.

environmentVariables.name: AUDREY_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the SQLite memory store (defaults to ~/.audrey/data)

environmentVariables.name: AUDREY_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Logical memory owner used for scoped operations (defaults to local-agent)

environmentVariables.name: AUDREY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: local (default, on-device model), openai, gemini, or mock

environmentVariables.name: AUDREY_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional reflection/consolidation model: anthropic, openai, chatgpt, or mock; unset keeps everything local

environmentVariables.name: AUDREY_ENABLE_ADMIN_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the export, import, forget, and promote tools
